name: Niobium
notes: Body-centered-cubic niobium. The reference cell is calculated from the published atomic V0. PhaseSmith calculates powder reflections and intensities from the ideal structure.

eos_records.label: Takemura and Singh (2006), helium-medium BM3
eos_records.reference: Takemura and Singh, Phys. Rev. B 73, 224119 (2006), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.73.224119
eos_records.notes: Helium-medium powder-XRD fit to 134 GPa. Published V0=17.98 A^3/atom is multiplied by two atoms in the conventional bcc cell; no phase transition was observed.
